facts.business: KEI Industries Limited manufactures cables and wires, including EHV cables up to 400 kV, and serves domestic and international markets across 60+ countries.

capacity_or_capex.item: Planned annual capital expenditure over the medium term
Expansion of wires capacity at Chinchpada
Planned investments at Salarpur and Kheda (Vadodara) to further expand capacity base

guidance_or_targets.statement: 20% Growth in FY 2026-27, supported primarily by new capacity at Sanand and expansion of wires capacity at Chinchpada

key_risks: Execution risk: Capacity must come onstream on time
Market development risk: Markets must develop alongside capacity
Conversion risk: Execution must convert capacity and market development into sustained performance
Forward-looking statement risks: Known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and factors that could cause actual results to differ materially
